domain: Systems of trust and transparency. Load-bearing infrastructure that makes a person's accumulated thinking durable, portable, and owned, independent of any single platform. Build what holds weight; repeat what is worth building on.
author: jp@pickeringdesigngroup.com

frameworks.name: Load-Bearing, Not Decorative
frameworks.principle: Build only what holds weight, what the next thing can stand on. If it does not bear load, it is decoration.

frameworks.name: User-Owned Continuity
frameworks.principle: The accumulated thinking, the context, frameworks, philosophy, and momentum, belongs to the person who created it, not the platform that hosted it. The continuity is theirs; the file is theirs.

frameworks.name: Trust as Infrastructure
frameworks.principle: Trust is built into how the system operates, local-first, transparent, user-owned, not asserted as a label. Access is a gate, not a flag.

frameworks.name: Build and Repeat What Is Worth Building On
frameworks.principle: Find the durable pattern, build it once and build it right, then reuse it so each build compounds instead of resetting.

frameworks.name: Doorway, Not House
frameworks.principle: Ship a small claim-staking wedge to start the flywheel while the real, durable vessel is built. The wedge is the door, not the house.

frameworks.name: Own the Lever
frameworks.principle: Control the part of the stack that becomes leverage over you if someone else owns it. Own the inference layer; retain ownership of what is built with AI rather than reselling access to someone else's.

vocabulary.term: The portal is not the AI; the portal is the continuity between minds
vocabulary.meaning: The product is the continuity, not the model. Models are interchangeable; the continuity is the asset.

vocabulary.term: If it doesn't hold weight, it's decoration
vocabulary.meaning: The test for whether a thing is infrastructure or ornament.

vocabulary.term: The continuity is yours. The file is yours.
vocabulary.meaning: User ownership stated plainly; the platform is a host, not an owner.

vocabulary.term: Trust is infrastructure; access is a gate, not a flag
The models are just plastic you press buttons on
vocabulary.meaning: Anti-mysticism. The model is a replaceable surface; the durable structure underneath is what matters.

vocabulary.term: The tool should lead, follow, or get out of the way
vocabulary.meaning: No sentiment. A tool works or it is a liability.

decision_patterns.name: Claim before ship
decision_patterns.rule: Securing the dated claim is cheap and fast; shipping is slow. They are separable; do the claim first.

decision_patterns.name: Counsel before contractor
decision_patterns.rule: Close legal and IP gates before unfreezing build. Sequence people by what is irreversible.

decision_patterns.name: Firewall the contractor
decision_patterns.rule: Scope tightly to the work surface; reveal nothing about the thesis, architecture, or adjacent products.

decision_patterns.name: Owner identity vs. worker identity
decision_patterns.rule: Legal, money, and IP on the owner identity; product and operational work on a separate worker identity. Never cross them.

decision_patterns.name: Keep the entity clean
decision_patterns.rule: Capital enters as a personal loan to the founder, not to the LLC; preserve single-member disregarded status; spin out sub-entities only when revenue justifies it.

decision_patterns.name: Underwrite on the floor
decision_patterns.rule: Build on the credible asset-backed floor. Treat speculative upside as trajectory, never as a schedule.

heuristics: If a secret touches a casual channel, it is burned.
New key, update consumers, verify, revoke old. Never revoke first.
Founder deploys; the contractor stages. No production tokens over an outside channel, ever.
Stake the claim with a dated, content-hashed artifact before you speak it aloud.
Do not let the rename gate the filings; parallel-track the naming.
Build it once, build it right, build it to be built upon.
